name: xovris
description: Xovris inside your AI agent: it watches what you run - sites, apps, APIs, domains, email, servers, networks and devices - finds what is wrong, fixes it and proves the fix. One install adds Xovris's tools and its way of working to every agent that reads Agent Plugins.

interface.defaultPrompt: Ask Xovris whether everything I run is working, and fix what is not.
